What happens after a container is too small

Find which layer no longer fits: First check whether content crosses the card boundary, then inspect the exact container's fixed height, max-height, overflow, and real scroll area. hidden only conceals the result; it does not explain why content no longer fits.

Essential content must remain visible or reachable: A normal content card should usually grow with its content. Use internal scrolling only for intentionally bounded lists or panels, with a visible cue. Do not silently clip an action, error, or primary content.

What it is not

Overflow is neither responsive design nor every kind of visual obstruction. If content stays inside its boundary but a fixed bar, absolutely positioned element, or another layer covers it, inspect positioning and stacking. Handle overflow when content actually crosses the container boundary; do not blindly hide it or raise z-index.
